metadata.name: deed_fun
metadata.description: Deed: Pump.fun creator-fee ownership (the Deed), escrowed auctions and OTC escrow

accounts.name: deed_token
docs: The claimant's token account holding the Deed.

accounts.name: closer
docs: Pays for the maker's token account if it no longer exists.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The wallet that will receive fees. It must already exist and hold the rent-exempt minimum, otherwise a 1% fee
credit to it could fail the rent check and block settlement.

accounts.name: previous_bidder
docs: first bid. Crediting lamports to any account cannot fail, so no bidder can block the next bid.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The coin's creator. Receives the Deed (it must already hold the single token) and pays the registry rent.

accounts.name: sharing_config
docs: validated in the handler.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The system-owned vault that Pump pays the creator fees into. Must be pre-funded with the rent-exempt minimum so
that any payout (even a tiny first one) leaves the account rent-exempt.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Pays for the winner's token account if it does not exist yet.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The (possibly new) treasury; same funding rule as at initialisation.

types.name: Auction
docs: An English auction of a Deed. PDA `["auction", deed_mint, nonce_le]`.
The Deed sits in this PDA's associated token account and the highest bid sits in this PDA's lamports.

fields.name: end_time
docs: Extended by anti-sniping. The program, not a server, decides when the auction ends.

fields.name: highest_bidder
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until the first bid.

fields.name: refunded_bidder
docs: The bidder that was outbid and refunded in this same transaction (`Pubkey::default()` for the first bid).

types.name: Config
docs: Program-wide settings. Singleton PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: May change the treasury. Nothing else: the fee rates are constants in the program.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives the 1% auction fee and the 0.5% OTC fee. Must be a wallet that already holds the rent minimum.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Chosen by the maker (any unique u64); part of the offer's address.

fields.name: amount
docs: Token base units.

fields.name: price_total
docs: Lamports for the WHOLE amount.

fields.name: min_fill
docs: Smallest partial fill. `amount` = all or nothing.

fields.name: counterparty
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = public offer.

fields.name: parent
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = not a counter offer.

types.name: DeedRegistered
docs: Events are the history the web app indexes (bids, fills, claims). Balances and states are read from accounts.

types.name: DeedState
docs: One per coin: the on-chain link between a Pump coin, its fee vault and its Deed (the 1/1 Ownership NFT).
PDA `["deed", coin_mint]`.

fields.name: sharing_config
docs: Pump Fees `SharingConfig` of the coin; it pays the creator fees to `vault`.

fields.name: creator
docs: The wallet that launched the coin and received the Deed.

fields.name: claimed_total
docs: Lifetime lamports paid out to Deed holders.

fields.name: auction_count
docs: Number of auctions ever opened for this Deed (also the next auction's nonce).

types.name: Offer
docs: A wallet-to-wallet OTC offer. PDA `["offer", maker, nonce_le]`.

fields.name: counterparty
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = public offer; otherwise only this wallet may fill or reject.

fields.name: parent
docs: The offer this one counters (`Pubkey::default()` = none).

fields.name: price_total
docs: Lamports for the WHOLE offer.

fields.name: min_fill
docs: Smallest partial fill (equal to `amount_total` = all or nothing). The last fill may be smaller.

fields.name: status
docs: 2 = cancelled by the maker, 3 = rejected by the named counterparty.
